EMPTY="$(bun run src/cli.ts plan "$TEST_DIR/empty.json")"

[ \""'$TIE" = '"'{\"order\":[\"a\",\"z\",\"end\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"z\"],[\"end\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2},\"end\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":3},\"z\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2}},\"totalDuration\":3,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\",\"end\"]}' ]

    echo "expected failure: $CASE" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

grep -F '"'finite non-negative number' \""'$TEST_DIR/bad-duration.err"
if bun run src/cli.ts nope "$TEST_DIR/dag.json" >"$TEST_DIR/cmd.out" 2>"$TEST_DIR/cmd.err"; then exit 1; fi
[ ! -s "$TEST_DIR/cmd.out" ]
grep -F '"'unknown command' \""'$TEST_DIR/cmd.err"
if bun run src/cli.ts plan "$TEST_DIR/dag.json" --wat >"$TEST_DIR/flag.out" 2>"$TEST_DIR/flag.err"; then exit 1; fi
[ ! -s "$TEST_DIR/flag.out" ]
grep -F '"'unknown flag' \""'$TEST_DIR/flag.err"
echo '"'SELF_TESTS_OK'"
